messages:
lucas-docs: heads up — opened PR #4271 to update the SDK snippet in the Private deploy guide. main change is switching the example from static key to KMS-managed key in the config. please review for PII/security exposure before merging. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4271
priya: thanks lucas. can you paste the snippet here? i want to do a quick content check for clarity and broken links.
lucas-docs: sure — pasted below (sanitized):
```python
config = {
  "kms_key": "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111222333444:key/EXAMPLE-KEY",
  "endpoint": "https://private.redwood/api",
}
```
priya: hmm that arn looks realistic. nina/legal + dave/security should weigh in. also the code fence renders fine locally but CI linkcheck flagged a relative anchor to #kms-setup previously.
nina-legal: @lucas-docs please do NOT include real-looking ARNs in public docs. open a redaction ticket and replace with a clearly synthetic placeholder like <REDACTED_KMS_ARN> or arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:012345678901:key/EXAMPLE. we need a short justification in the ticket for audit.
dave-security: agree with nina. i'll run a branch scan for AWS account patterns and any other credentials. also recommend adding a short note in the PR description that no customer data was used and that this is a fabricated example.
rachel-eng: small nit — the SDK snippet uses an old field name kms_key; our current SDK uses kms_key_arn. can we update the code sample to match the client API? i'll open a small patch if you want.
ci-bot: docs-preview: linkcheck failed  1 broken anchor: #kms-setup referenced from private-deploy.md line 210. full log: https://ci.internal.redwood/docs/4271/logs/checks
github: PR #4271  lucas-docs updated private-deploy.md (branch: docs/sdk-kms-example). Status: checks failing, merge blocked. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4271
jamie-release: FYI release cut for Private docs refresh is tomorrow 15:00 PT. if this is sensitive we may need to push to a patch after the cut; otherwise target merge before 13:30 PT to be included in the release candidate.
lucas-docs: opened REDACT-301 and linked the PR, included the original snippet and a note saying it was fabricated but used a real-looking id. link: https://tracker.internal.redwood/REDACT-301
priya: updated the snippet to use kms_key_arn and replaced the ARN with arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:012345678901:key/EXAMPLE. pushed the change to branch. also fixed the anchor to point to /docs/private/#kms-setup (absolute path).
dave-security: running quick scrub now. found one more suspicious numeric pattern in examples/terraform/main.tf — attaching output to REDACT-301. hold merge until scrubbed.
nina-legal: reviewing REDACT-301. if everything is fabricated and replaced with synthetic values we can approve quickly. i'll ack here once ticket closed.
ci-bot: docs-preview: rerun queued for PR #4271. status: linkcheck in progress.
lucas-docs: thanks all. if legal signs off and ci passes, please @approve on the PR. i'll add a changelog line noting the snippet fix.
jamie-release: noted. we'll watch for the approval and CI success. if not by 13:30 PT we'll schedule for the post-release patch window.
priya: small follow-up — added a short paragraph under the snippet clarifying this is an example and not production advice (token/permission guidance). pushed to branch.
nina-legal: REDACT-301 closed  confirmed synthetic values, security attachments reviewed. good to go from legal.
dave-security: branch scrub clear except the terraform example which is now updated. marked as cleared in REDACT-301.
ci-bot: docs-preview: all checks passed for PR #4271.
github: PR #4271  Status: checks passed, reviewers requested approval. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4271
rachel-eng: reviewed and approved the API naming fix. @priya can you give a content + style approval?
priya: approved  looks good to me.
lucas-docs: thanks everyone — merging now and marking the PR with the REDACT ticket. will follow up in release notes. :tada:
